title: Developer Handshake Deck: micro-screens for API key exchange, live-pipes, and tool-call previews
creator: Leah Kim
description: Create a focused set of micro-screens and a spritesheet for the developer docs that explain the API key handshake, an in-browser 'live-pipe' streaming preview, and a single-panel tool-call preview. Deliverables: 6 responsive PNG mockups (desktop/tablet/phone variants), a Figma file with componentized artboards, alt text strings for each screen, short animation specs (CSS-friendly), and a copy-approved microcopy sheet. Design should be lightweight and match Console's brand tokens; prioritize clarity for first-run engineers integrating SDKs.
acceptance_criteria: Six distinct artboards covering: key exchange, key rotation, live-pipe streaming demo, tool-call preview, error states, and success confirmation
Each artboard has desktop/tablet/mobile variants exported at 2x and 3x
All screens include accessible color contrast and aria-label recommendations in the alt text sheet
Figma file with components and tokens linked and a handoff page for engineering
Microcopy reviewed by PM and legal for no misleading security claims
Exported assets uploaded to Drive and referenced in docs PR
